raw:
@q query
  mode every
  where match
    relation "be a player of"
    role subject ?p
    role object "the Reșitza Falcons"
    polarity affirmed
  end
  scope match
    relation "complete"
    role subject ?p
    role object "the safety training"
    polarity affirmed
  end
